invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.092（基于ATR 0.0006和约1%风险），或融资费率Z-score持续高于100%且价格停滞，或日线跌破$0.088关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.092 (based on ATR 0.0006 and ~1% risk), or funding Z-score remains above 100% with price stagnation, or daily break below $0.088 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$77（基于ATR 0.5255和约3.6%风险），或融资费率转为负值（<-0.01%）显示轧多机会消失，或日线跌破$75关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $77 (based on ATR 0.5255 and ~3.6% risk), or funding rate turns negative (<-0.01%) indicating long squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $75 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2120，或融资费率转为正值（>0.01%）显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$2040关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2120, or funding rate turns positive (>0.01%) indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $2040 key support.
